evidence.note: CONFIRMED: `ddflow approvals --help` lists subcommands {list,pending,log,show,request,ask,attest,approve,deny,revoke,withdraw} — no `answer` verb exists. `ddflow/services/approvals/answer.py` answer() passes only outcome+digest to E.answer (no text), and `api/approvals_answer.py` approve/deny only answer APPROVAL asks (outcome approved/denied); engine._check_answerable refuses those for a type==question row. Cheapest probe: `ddflow approvals answer Qxxxxx --text red` fails as an unknown subcommand.

Add a CLI-only `approvals answer <id> --text T` verb (a persons act, no MCP tool, mirroring approve/deny: tests/test_approvals_cli.py) that calls engine.answer with outcome=selected-option (options question) or outcome=answered+text (free-text). Answer verbs stay tool="" per D-RA-6 (MCP never answers). Repoint the digest question source command in sources.py + collect_asks.py to the new verb. Regression test first in tests/test_question_ask_surfaces.py.

Added `ddflow approvals answer <id> --text T` verb (api/approvals_answer.py approvals_answer; services/approvals/answer.py answer() text passthrough; surfaces declared/commands/parsers approvals; person-only, tool="") answering a question ask (outcome=option for multiple-choice, outcome=answered+text for free text). Repointed digest question source command (sources.py + collect_asks.py) to `ddflow approvals answer <id> --text <answer>`. Regression tests added. Smoke: asked Q3e8020317b, `ddflow approvals answer Q3e8020317b --text red` -> "Q3e8020317b answered by delian"; row state=answered outcome=answered answer=red.

chunk_findings.detail: The queue command for a question ask is not a command an operator can run. For ask Q9, `collect_asks` now sets `command` to `ddflow approvals answer Q9 --text <answer>` (and `ddflow approvals answer 'weird id' --text <answer>` when the id needs quoting). In a shell, an unquoted `<answer>` is stdin redirection from a file named `answer`, not a placeholder, so pasting the suggested line fails with a missing file or never passes `--text`. Approve rows stay a real verb (`ddflow approvals approve {rid}`); question rows, the case this bug was opened for, are not. `tests/test_digest_queue.py` locks the broken string in, so the regression never catches it. Quote the placeholder (`--text '<answer>'`) or omit `--text` until a real answer exists.
